description: Deterministically verify a WCAG fix with the real Playwright + axe-core engine. URL mode re-scans a live page; snippet mode diffs original vs fixed HTML before deploy. Returns MEASURED facts: targetCleared, newViolations (regressions), resolvedViolations, and complianceDelta. This is the authoritative "did the fix work?" signal.

baseline.description: URL mode: pre-fix violation set for a full new/resolved delta (max 5000 entries)

fixedHtml.description: Fixed HTML to verify (snippet mode; requires originalHtml)

originalHtml.description: Original failing HTML (snippet mode; requires fixedHtml)

ruleId.description: Axe-core rule ID the fix was meant to resolve (e.g. "button-name")

url.description: Live/deployed URL to re-scan (URL mode; preferred when a URL exists)

name: aether_verify_fix
